moments.title: Strictly Comes Back!
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing begins with its highly anticipated launch show this Saturday, revealing the celebrity-pro pairings.

angles.name: Launch Night Excitement
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-cha! Strictly Come Dancing is back on Saturday night for its big launch. Who are you hoping gets paired with who? #Strictly

angles.name: New Hosts & Judges
angles.copy: New hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe take the reins, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood on the judging panel. Tune in Saturday at 7:25pm!

moments.title: Bake Off Returns with Nigella
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returns for its 17th series on Tuesday, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: Nigella's Debut
angles.copy: Get your aprons on! The Great British Bake Off is back on Tuesday with a brand new judge, Nigella Lawson! Ready for some deliciously comforting telly?

angles.name: First Signature Challenge
angles.copy: New tent, new bakers, new judge! What do you think the first Signature Challenge will be for the new series of Bake Off? Tuesday, 8pm on Channel 4.

moments.title: Autumnal Equinox Arrives
moments.blurb: The Autumnal Equinox officially marks the beginning of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, at 1:05 AM BST.

angles.name: Official Start of Autumn
angles.copy: It's official: Autumn begins on Wednesday! The Autumnal Equinox arrives, meaning shorter days and longer nights are here. Time for cosy jumpers and pumpkin spice everything?

angles.name: Seasonal Change
angles.copy: The nights draw in as the Autumnal Equinox hits on Wednesday. Say goodbye to summer and hello to golden leaves and crisp air!

moments.title: Equinox Festival Underway
moments.blurb: The multi-genre Equinox Festival is currently taking place in Lincoln, running from September 17-21, featuring over 100 artists.

angles.name: Live Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Equinox Festival is LIVE in Lincoln right now! If you're there, soaking up the tunes across multiple genres, give us a shout!

angles.name: Weekend Festival Reminder
angles.copy: Still time to catch some of the action at Equinox Festival! Running until Monday, it's bringing multi-genre vibes to Lincoln.

moments.title: Homobloc Returns to Manchester
moments.blurb: The renowned dance music festival Homobloc takes over Manchester on Saturday, September 26, for a day of electronic music.

angles.name: Dance Festival Hype
angles.copy: Manchester's getting ready to rave! Homobloc is back on Saturday 26th September. Who's heading to one of the UK's biggest dance events?

angles.name: Manchester Event
angles.copy: Big weekend for Manchester coming up! Homobloc brings the best in dance music to the city this Saturday. Get ready for an epic day!

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart Revealed
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart is updated every Friday, with the latest chart for the week announced tomorrow, September 18.

angles.name: Chart Friday Anticipation
angles.copy: It's almost Friday, which means a brand new Official UK Singles Chart is dropping tomorrow! Any predictions for the Number 1? #OfficialCharts

angles.name: Who's Top?
angles.copy: What tracks are you hoping to see climb the Official UK Singles Chart tomorrow? We'll have the rundown as soon as it's announced!

moments.title: Happy 58th Anastacia!
moments.blurb: Pop powerhouse Anastacia, known for hits like 'I'm Outta Love', celebrates her 58th birthday today.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to the incredible Anastacia, who turns 58 today! Still got that 'Sprock' sound!

angles.name: Classic Hit Mention
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to the 'Little Lady with The Big Voice', Anastacia! 'I'm Outta Love' still sounds as good today as it did back then.

moments.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
moments.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on Monday, September 21.

angles.name: Oasis Icon
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 on Monday! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis track?

angles.name: Rock'n'Roll Star
angles.copy: Still a rock'n'roll star at 54! Liam Gallagher celebrates his birthday on Monday. Got to be 'Live Forever' as a birthday anthem!

moments.title: The Boss Turns 77
moments.blurb: Legendary rock and roll icon Bruce Springsteen, known as 'The Boss', celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday, September 23.

angles.name: Birthday for The Boss
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Bruce Springsteen on Wednesday! The Boss is still 'Born To Run'.

angles.name: Celebrating a Legend
angles.copy: 77 years young on Wednesday! Wishing a very happy birthday to the legendary Bruce Springsteen. What's your favourite Boss anthem?

moments.title: Will Smith's 58th Birthday
moments.blurb: Actor and Grammy-winning musician Will Smith, famous as The Fresh Prince, turns 58 on Friday, September 25.

angles.name: Fresh Prince Birthday
angles.copy: Now this is a story all about how... Will Smith turns 58 on Friday! Still got those Fresh Prince vibes.

angles.name: Music & Movie Icon
angles.copy: From rap hits to blockbusters, Will Smith is 58 this Friday! Wishing a very happy birthday to the multi-talented star.

moments.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones Turns 57
moments.blurb: Welsh actress and Oscar-winner Catherine Zeta-Jones celebrates her 57th birthday on Friday, September 25.

angles.name: Welsh Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Penblwydd Hapus to our very own Catherine Zeta-Jones, who turns 57 on Friday! A true Welsh icon.

angles.name: Hollywood Star
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to the stunning Catherine Zeta-Jones this Friday! From Swansea to Hollywood, an incredible career.

moments.title: Avril Lavigne's 42nd Birthday
moments.blurb: Pop-punk princess Avril Lavigne, known for hits like 'Complicated', celebrates her 42nd birthday on Sunday, September 27.

angles.name: Pop-Punk Princess
angles.copy: Can you believe Avril Lavigne turns 42 on Sunday?! Still rocking the pop-punk scene like it's 2002. Happy Birthday, Avril!

angles.name: Still Complicated
angles.copy: No, it's not 'Complicated' – Avril Lavigne is 42 this Sunday! Wishing a very happy birthday to the pop-punk icon.
